note: One Commons photo per azimuth slot. azimuthDeg is where the camera stands about the statue: 0 = in front of the figure, +90 = at the figure's own left hand, 180 = behind. Slots were read off the photos (face or back visible, which way the figure turns); boxes are rough crops containing figure + plinth top, in pixels of the 1200 px cache copies. Seven views: no usable Commons photo shows the figure from behind its right shoulder (every back view is taken from the square side, behind-left), so -135 is covered by the -90 and 180 neighbours. Rejected after a bake: a127 (head lost against foliage), a121 (figure 130 px tall, and it faces away-left, i.e. +135, not -135). See docs/sculptures.md.
